title: Oceanic Creamy Portuguese Shrimp Pasta
description: A sour and creamy weeknight Portuguese dish featuring shrimp, with a hint of Cajun spice, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and add the garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside, then add the cajun seasoning and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lemon juice to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer, cooking for 2-3 minutes until slightly reduced.
Stir in the salt and black pepper, then return the cooked shrimp to the skillet and toss to coat with the cream sauce.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the shrimp and cream sauce.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
